prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Phoenix to fix my air conditioning?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one single “best” HVAC company for everyone — the right contractor depends on your exact location in Phoenix, the type and age of your system, whether it’s an emergency, and your budget. I can recommend local companies, but first a few quick, practical points and next steps so you get a reliable fix.

What to do right now
- If it’s an emergency (no cooling in triple-digit heat), say so — request emergency same‑day service and ask about response time and emergency fees.  
- If not urgent, get at least 2–3 quotes for the repair so you can compare price and scope.

How to pick a good Phoenix HVAC company
- Verify Arizona ROC license and liability insurance. Ask for the license number and confirm it on the Arizona Registrar of Contractors site.  
- Look for NATE‑certified technicians (North American Technician Excellence).  
- Check recent Google/Yelp reviews and the BBB rating — read a mix of good and bad reviews to see how they handle problems.  
- Ask about diagnostic fee, what the fee covers, and whether it’s waived if you proceed with repairs.  
- Get a written estimate with parts, labor, timeline, and warranty on parts and labor.  
- Ask whether they use OEM parts and if they’ll pull permits (if required).  
- Ask about maintenance plans if you want to avoid future breakdowns.

Companies commonly recommended in Phoenix
(You should still vet each one using the checklist above.)
- Goettl Air Conditioning — long‑established Phoenix company with strong local presence.  
- One Hour Heating & Air Conditioning (Phoenix franchise) — often available for emergency calls/guaranteed arrival windows.  
- Service Experts Heating & Air Conditioning — national brand with local Phoenix service teams.  
- ARS/Rescue Rooter (HVAC division) — large service network, emergency service options.  
- Local independent HVAC shops — often competitive on price and personalized service; verify license and reviews.

If you want a targeted recommendation
Tell me your ZIP code and whether it’s urgent, the make/model or age of your unit if known, and whether you prefer a big company or a local independent. I’ll give 3 nearby, highly rated options and a short script with the exact questions to ask when you call.
